overview.summary: Across Jun 19–25 to Jul 6–19 (New All 10Gbps Portfolio → Start of Retail hand-off), AI conversion moved from 17% to 7.7% (-9.3ppts), while Sign Ups AI went from 2.9 to 1.3 (-1.6). The main story is softer AI close-out despite stable lead intake.

insights.text: Lead engagement held up: Contact Rate is 72.8% (-1.2ppts vs first period) with Total Leads at 23.1.
AI close metrics weakened — Conversion Rate 7.7% and Sign Ups AI 1.3. Investigate hand-off quality and duplicate/existing-customer mix.
Retail hand-off is in view. Align AI and Retail on duplicate/existing customers so fallout after AI contact can be recovered without dropping reported Sign Ups and Conversion.

items.title: Close more of the customers AI already contacts
items.detail: Contact Rate is strong at 72.8%, but Sign Ups AI is only 1.3 and Conversion 7.7%. Improve the post-reply close: clearer offer, urgency, and next-step CTA so more replied customers become AI sign-ups.

items.title: Strengthen AI consultative spiel to lift conversion
items.detail: Conversion fell from 17% to 7.7%. Refresh AI scripts for objections (price, speed, existing plan) and A/B test consultative vs promotional wording to recover close rate.

items.title: Reduce AI lost leads before they drop
items.detail: Lost Leads AI is 2.4 (rate 15%). Add same-session recovery prompts, follow-up sequences, and clearer value proof when customers hesitate — convert them inside AI instead of letting them go cold.

items.title: Prioritize high-intent leads for AI close effort
items.detail: With Sign Ups AI at 1.3, score intent (timeline, plan interest, eligibility) and put AI close energy on the hottest replies first — fewer shallow chats, more completed conversions.

retailLearn.summary: During Retail hand-off (Jul 6–19), AI Sign Ups dropped to 1.3 and Conversion to 7.7%, while Contact Rate stayed relatively healthy at 72.8%. Retail converted the fallout AI did not finish — especially duplicate and existing customers — by clarifying account status, matching the right plan, and closing the same leads AI had already engaged.

prompts.why: Retail win → AI prompt: own the existing/duplicate customer path
prompts.text: If the customer is an existing or duplicate account, do not stop at a soft hand-off. Confirm account status, explain upgrade/retention options clearly, and ask for a sign-up decision in the same conversation.

prompts.why: Retail win → AI prompt: recover hesitant fallout before losing the lead
prompts.text: When a customer hesitates after contact, treat it as a recoverable close: restate the value, handle price/speed/existing-plan objections, offer one best-fit plan, and ask a direct close question before marking the lead lost.

prompts.why: Retail win → AI prompt: consultative close, not just contact
prompts.text: After a reply, act like a Retail closer: diagnose need, recommend one plan, remove friction (eligibility, install, billing), and use a clear CTA — "Shall I proceed with your sign-up now?"

prompts.why: Retail win → AI prompt: keep context and finish the sale
prompts.text: Never restart discovery if intent is already known. Reuse what the customer said (speed need, budget, existing plan), personalize the offer, and complete conversion in-chat whenever the customer is eligible.
